ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, side ab of the right-triangular metal frame abc is in the vertical direction on the left side, and coincides with the dashed rotation axis; b is above, a is below, and side bc extends horizontally to the right from point b on the axis to point c. The arrow of magnetic field B is vertically upward, with direction parallel to side ab. The figure indicates that the metal frame rotates counterclockwise about side ab with angular velocity ω. Reasoning: The problem asks for the potential difference Ubc, understood as Ubc=Ub-Uc. For a small segment of metal on side bc at distance r from the rotation axis ab, because it rotates about ab, the magnitude of its linear velocity is v=ωr, and the direction is tangential. According to the right-hand rule, when B is vertically upward and the rotation direction is as shown in the figure, v×B is along bc from b to c, therefore the magnetic-field force on positive charges is along b to c, and positive charges are pushed toward the c end. The motional electromotive force of segment bc from b to c is ∫_0^l Bωr dr = 1/2 Bωl^2. When the metal reaches electrostatic equilibrium, the direction of the internal electrostatic field is opposite to v×B, namely along c to b, so the potential at point c is higher than that at point b. Therefore Ub-Uc = -1/2 Bωl^2.

method.method_draft: 直接用运动电动势积分求bc段两端电势差。先从图中读出ab是转轴，bc从轴上的b点水平伸到c点，因此bc段上各点到转轴的距离r从0变到l；磁场B沿ab向上，转动方向为逆时针。由题文读取B、角速度ω、bc长度l以及要求Ubc=Ub-Uc。对bc上一点，速度大小v=ωr，方向为切向；用右手定则判断在B向上、逆时针转动时，v×B沿bc由b指向c，正电荷被推向c。运动电动势沿b到c为∫_0^l Bωr dr=1/2 Bωl^2。金属达到静电平衡时电场方向与v×B相反，因此c点电势高于b点，Ub-Uc=-1/2Bωl^2。
